families.evidence: Mesh_CloneInto returns Mesh pointers stored by the loader and assigned to SceneNode::pObject. The parallel arrays contain byte clone indices and integer classifications, allocated at runtime.

RallyData_RebuildSectorStaticObjectTables allocates separate native entry, bounds and packed short projection arrays. Each entry stores StageObject* at 0 and bounds* at 4; Collision_BuildObjectPointBounds writes six shorts through bounds+4. All native producers, pointer tables, consumers and duplicated moving-record declarations move together. Disk StageObject/Mesh/mesh collision-record layouts retain their original Win32 sizes, while the port still requires disk/native separation.
